text:
Unfortunately, that combination isn't possible. A 5 ft rubber plant counts as an XL plant (usually over 4 ft), and XL plants ship Standard only, so Express isn't available for it.

Here's what you'd pay with Standard shipping to zone 2 (3-5 business days):
- **$20 XL handling fee**
- **$7.95 Standard shipping**, which is free if your order is $75 or more after discounts and before tax

Live plants ship Monday to Wednesday only. If you order after 12 noon on Wednesday, it ships the following Monday. I can't see the plant's price here, so I can't give you the final total.
